AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Crop Management Practises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Preparing Animal Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
